breadth.label: Percent of S&P 500 stocks above 50-day MA
breadth.note: Below 30 bullish, above 70 bearish. Computed by Thaddeus from Yahoo Finance daily closes for 501 of 503 current S&P 500 constituents at the Nov. 17 close (mimics MMFI). Down from 65.1%.

fear_greed.commentary: Fear & Greed slipped to 25 (fear) from 31 on Monday and 36 a week ago, right at the edge of extreme fear, as the AI-led sell-off deepened; it is still above 18 a month ago.

markets.summary: Wall Street fell for a fourth straight session as AI and chip stocks sold off ahead of Nvidia's report. The S&P 500 slid 1.0% to 7,340.53, its lowest close since July, the Dow dropped 1.6% to 50,759.42 and the Nasdaq 0.7% to 24,328.38, and all three now sit below their 40-week averages. Small caps fell as well, with the Russell 2000 down 1.5% to 2,701.87 and below its 40-week average. The 10-year Treasury yield eased to about 5.10%, though markets still price a likely Fed hike in December. Gold futures edged up 0.3% to about $3,864 and silver futures rose 1.1% to about $47.29 after Monday's sharp losses, but both remain well below their 40-week averages and near one-year lows. After the bell, Nvidia beat estimates with $115.8 billion in revenue and guided next quarter to about $130 billion, and the stock rose more than 3% in extended trading, a potential relief for tech on Wednesday.

stories.headline: Nvidia (NVDA) Q3 2027 earnings report: live updates
stories.summary: Nvidia beat on profit and revenue ($2.68 adjusted EPS vs. $2.48 expected; $115.84 billion vs. $109.10 billion) and guided to about $130 billion next quarter; the stock rose more than 3% after hours in its first report since Jensen Huang's resignation as CEO.

stories.headline: NVIDIA Announces Financial Results for Third Quarter Fiscal 2027
stories.summary: Revenue of $115.8 billion was up 20% from the prior quarter and 103% from a year ago, with a Q4 outlook of $130 billion plus or minus 3% that assumes no China data center compute revenue.

stories.headline: SpaceX stock rises 3.2% after CFO outlines AI plans
stories.summary: SPCX closed at $141.70, up 3.16%, as CFO Bret Johnsen discussed moving AI data centers into space at the TomorrowX Summit and said much of the buildout can be self-funded, while noting customer concentration and heavy spending as risks.

headlines.headline: How major US stock indexes fared Tuesday 11/17/2026
headlines.summary: Nvidia and other jittery AI stocks led widespread losses, with the S&P 500 down 1% after swinging between nearly flat and a 1.7% loss.

headlines.headline: Dow drops more than 800 points, S&P 500 posts lowest close since July
headlines.summary: Chip stocks were sold ahead of Nvidia's earnings, and reports of a National Security Agency network outage added to jitters; the Nasdaq hit its lowest level in about seven months.

headlines.headline: Gold struggles near one-year lows, silver rebounds as stocks slide, Fed hike bets persist
headlines.summary: Spot gold was little changed near $3,853 while silver rebounded about 1% to roughly $47.33 on weaker economic data and lower Treasury yields.

stories.summary: Satire: a diplomatic compliment that confuses a nation with a book of Scripture.

stories.headline: Mamdani Says City-Owned Grocery Stores Won't Carry Luxury Items Such As Food
stories.summary: Satire: New York's municipal grocery plan trims the inventory down to the essentials, minus the food.

stories.headline: 9 Easy Ways To Show Generosity This Holiday Season
stories.summary: Satire: a holiday-season listicle of generosity tips, Bee style.

weather.summary: A slow-moving upper low over the Gulf and Southeast will keep training thunderstorms going along eastern Florida through Thursday, with a Moderate Risk of flash flooding on the Space and Treasure Coasts. Out West, a Pacific trough and atmospheric river bring periods of heavy rain and a Slight Risk of flash flooding to central and southern California. Heavy mountain snow hits the Sierra through Thursday, and accumulating snow spreads into parts of the Intermountain West and Rockies.

stories.headline: No. 14 Tennessee hands No. 2 Michigan State its first loss, 61-46
stories.summary: The Spartans jumped out to an early 10-point lead in Knoxville, then shot just 9-of-50 from the field; Tennessee led 27-25 at the half and pulled away after the break. Jeremy Fears Jr. scored 16 for MSU.

stories.headline: New I-25 Crystal Valley interchange in Castle Rock set to fully open
stories.summary: Exit 179 at Crystal Valley Parkway was slated to fully open over the weekend, serving a fast-growing south Castle Rock where Douglas County's population has grown almost 24% in a decade.

stories.headline: CN Rail train plunges into Skeena River near Terrace, B.C.
stories.summary: A rockslide sent a locomotive and five cars into the river on Nov. 17; two people were hospitalized in serious but stable condition, and CN says no dangerous goods were aboard.

stories.headline: A week of major outages hits Microsoft, FAA, Chase and the NSA
stories.summary: At least five major US systems failed in a week, stoking sabotage fears, though cybersecurity researchers say brittle systems may be a simpler explanation.

stories.headline: Russia hits Kyiv bridges as Ukraine strikes Crimean bridge again
stories.summary: Strikes on the North and South bridges cut water, power and parts of the metro in Kyiv, while Ukraine says it seriously damaged the Crimean bridge in retaliation.

stories.headline: Lawmakers demand answers on recent tech outages
stories.summary: Members of Congress are pressing the administration for explanations after the string of Microsoft, FAA and JPMorgan disruptions.
